preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array a must be integers between 1 and 10^9.
The length of the array a must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(a_u > a_v for u in range(n) for v in range(u + 1, n)) else True
postconditions.description: If no inversions exist, output -1; otherwise, output a valid list of inversion pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(a[u] <= a[v] for u in range(n) for v in range(u + 1, n))
postconditions.description: After processing all pairs, the array a must be sorted in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.expression: len(pairs) == m and all(1 <= u_i < v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in pairs)
postconditions.description: The number of pairs m must be valid, and each pair (u_i, v_i) must be distinct and form an inversion.
